_: The new Elise (the owner's Tripo elise_anim_pack.glb, Mixamo rig): the game's hero clip names cut from the pack's clips (art/tools/glb_game_clips.mjs). window: [start, end] seconds of the pack clip; the extras are what play/iris-avatar.js reads (impact_s, release_s, step_s: the window starts just before the hand or foot speed peak, art/heroes/peaks.py, so a strike lands within 0.13-0.18 s, a cast lets go at 0.1 s and slash1 hits at 0.3 s like the game's old keyed moves). Walk: one stride of the pack walk (its clip holds two). Run: one stride of flee_01 (owner 14.11: the pack run is a sprint and read terribly fast at our 3.3 m/s; flee_01 is a jog with bent arms), its window shifted so the left foot lands in the same phase as in the walk (the gait blends both on one stride phase). Speed: the hips travel over the window in the pack (art/heroes/runmeasure.py); contact: each foot's landing as a fraction of the stride (the footstep events). The pack run is not a clean cycle: the window is the closest-pose pair (14 deg at worst, art/heroes/loopcut2.py).
